krylov_sequence: Cyclic shifts; initial span contains constant-pressure mode and three source vectors; each iteration solves on the last three real orthonormal basis vectors and appends orthogonalized real and imaginary parts.
krylov_orthogonalization: Two projection passes followed by rank-revealing pivoted economic QR; relative numerical rank tolerance 1e-12; final thin QR of the complete basis.
krylov_source_conditioning: The basis uses the three evaluated source vectors. No claim of generalization to unseen sources.
error_sampling: All 641 output times, including t=0; equal weights over times and source columns.
timing_policy: Three sequential repetitions per setting after a common small-problem warm-up. Every reduced dimension is built independently; full assembly and basis cost charged for one three-source query. File I/O, error calculation and structure diagnostics excluded. All raw timings retained.
full_model_output: All full pressure states are generated by the sparse first-order exponential; pressure conversion and receiver observation timed separately. Full-state propagation cost shared by receiver-only and field-output totals.
physical_scope: Nondimensional lossless heterogeneous rigid cavity, independently sampled analytic positive coefficients. Comparisons are on the same propagation grid.
